maria.s: eval-bot alerted: nightly QA-suite BLEU dropped 18 points for rdx-7b-quant-int8 on the latest canary run. dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/evals/2034567890 :eyes:

maria.s: summary from eval-bot: metric=BLEU, baseline=42.1, canary=24.3, suite=qa-long-context, model=rdx-7b-quant-int8-beam, commit=runtime@f3a2b7

cheng.k: ugh. was there a runtime change yesterday?

jenna.t: @cheng.k yes changed beam-search default from 4->8 in runtime patch to handle some diversity cases. rolled to canary at 03:00 UTC.

dmitri.r: initial thought: doubling beam width increases search space but with int8 quant + packed-KV we sometimes see score ordering shifts. that can produce different argmax and blow up BLEU on strict qa sets.

maria.s: attaching a diff sample from the failed prompt (short):

maria.s: ```
PROMPT: "Who wrote "The Origin of Species"?"
BASELINE: "Charles Darwin wrote The Origin of Species in 1859."
CANARY: "It was first described by multiple scientists; notable mentions include Wallace and others."
```

cheng.k: that canonical answer turning into ambiguous reply is consistent with beam exploring more low-prob mass sequences. do we have logits comparison?

maria.s: i ran run_eval locally with --dump-logits for 3 examples. baseline runtime f28a vs canary f3a2b7. attaching tiny excerpt:

maria.s: ```
TOKEN  logits_base  logits_canary
Charles  -1.2        -1.3
Darwin   -0.9        -1.5
Wallace  -2.4        -2.0
```

jenna.t: looks like quantized logits shifted relative ordering for Darwin vs Wallace under beam width 8. with beam 4 baseline still picks Darwin.

dmitri.r: hypothesis: interaction of increased beam width + int8 quantization noise causing re-ranking to prefer lexical variants. two contributors: (1) beam width change, (2) newer packed-KV alignment tweak in runtime f3a2b7 that changed attention indexing at the low-bit kernels.

ops-bot: deploy-f3a2b7 is currently on canary pool canary-gpu-7 (10% of traffic). rollback candidate queued.

maria.s: immediate mitigation suggestion: rollback runtime to f28a on canary, pin quant profile to q-profile-v2 for rdx-7b-quant-int8, tighten nightly gating for qa-long-context (BLEU >= 40).

cheng.k: agree rollback canary now. also we should run targeted eval matrix: beams=[4,8], quant=[v1,v2], runtime=[f28a,f3a2b7] to confirm interaction. i'll own that. ETA 2 hrs for full matrix results.

jenna.t: i'll open a canary rollback: `./infra/rollback --deploy canary-gpu-7 --to f28a` and hold deploy. will post status.

ops-bot: rollback started by jenna.t at 2034567905.

maria.s: long-term mitigation: add gating rule in our model onboarding flow: when quantized model goes to canary, require passing qa-long-context BLEU >= baseline-2 for all beam widths in {1,4,8} and require that quantization profile is pinned until explicit approval. also add a runtime-change canary window where beam/default-decoding config changes require an opt-in on canary with canary duration 48h and a regen-eval pass.

dmitri.r: action items (short):
- reproduce matrix + post artifacts (cheng.k)
- rollback canary (jenna.t) -> done in progress
- pin quant-profile for rdx-7b-quant-int8 (maria.s)
- add gating checks to onboarding pipeline + nightly-eval (dmitri.r + eng-devex)
- add a regression alert for >10 BLEU drop on qa-long-context (maria.s)

maria.s: i'll create the incident writeup and a follow-up RFC for gating. initial root cause (draft): "beam width increase + quantization-induced logit reorder + KV alignment tweak in runtime f3a2b7 combined to change re-ranking behavior on strict QA prompts, causing a BLEU regression."

maria.s: PRs i'll open: rollback infra PR, pin-quant-profile change, nightly-eval gating rule. linking here once created.

jenna.t: rollback completed at 2034567918. canary now at f28a. monitoring metrics.

ops-bot: canary rollback verified: baseline metrics restored on quick smoke.

cheng.k: matrix run started. preliminary confirms BLEU drop reproduced only when (beam>=8 AND runtime=f3a2b7 AND quant=v2). when beam=4 it's fine.

maria.s: thanks team. next steps: keep canary pinned to f28a for 24h, run full nightly on canary pool with beam tests. we'll reconvene if anything else pops. :white_check_mark:

maria.s: root-cause summary + mitigation checklist will be added to #postmortems and i will file the follow-up RFC for gating rules this afternoon.

jenna.t: @maria.s can you also add a unit-test in runtime that asserts deterministic ordering for top-k under quant thresholds? might catch similar changes earlier.

maria.s: yup adding that to the RFC action items.

maria.s: closing thread for now. thanks all. :raised_hands:
